layout.grid-template-areas: "side hero hero" "side live live" "side athan media" "side system media"

ha-card { background: none !important; border: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; backdrop-filter: none !important; -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important; } ha-card { padding: 0 4px !important; }
style.ha-markdown$: h1 { font-size: 84px; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: -3px; line-height: 1; margin: 4px 0 14px; } p { margin: 2px 0; font-size: 18px; opacity: 0.92; }

cards.primary: {{ (state_attr('weather.forecast_home', 'temperature') or 0) | round(0) }}°C · {{ states('weather.forecast_home') | replace('partlycloudy', 'partly cloudy') | replace('clear-night', 'clear') | title }}
cards.secondary: Humidity {{ state_attr('weather.forecast_home', 'humidity') }}% · Wind {{ (state_attr('weather.forecast_home', 'wind_speed') or 0) | round(0) }} {{ state_attr('weather.forecast_home', 'wind_speed_unit') }}

cards.title: Today's prayers

ha-card .card-header { font-size: 13px !important; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.75; padding-bottom: 0 !important; }
style.ha-markdown$: table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 18px; } td, th, tr { border: none !important; } td { padding: 8px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12) !important; } tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none !important; } td:last-child { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

cards.content:
{% set next = states('sensor.next_prayer') | lower %}{% set p = state_attr('sensor.prayer_times_today', 'prayers') or {} %}{% for key, label in [('fajr','Fajr'),('shurooq','Sunrise'),('dhuhr','Dhuhr'),('asr','Asr'),('maghrib','Maghrib'),('isha','Isha')] %}{% set t = (p.get(key) or {}).get('effective', '–') %}{% if key == next %}{% else %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}
{{ label }}{{ t }}{{ label }}{{ t }}

style.ha-markdown$: h2 { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.8; margin: 0 0 4px; } h1 { font-size: 64px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.05; margin: 0; letter-spacing: -1.5px; } p { font-size: 20px; margin: 10px 0 0; opacity: 0.92; }

card_mod.style: ha-card { background: none !important; border: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; backdrop-filter: none !important; }

ha-card { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95) !important; --primary-text-color: #2a1150; --secondary-text-color: #2a1150; --tile-color: #f0266f; min-height: 132px; justify-content: center; } ha-tile-icon { --tile-icon-size: 64px; --tile-icon-color: #f0266f; color: #f0266f; --tile-icon-border-radius: 20px; } .container { padding: 18px 22px !important; gap: 18px; } .content { gap: 20px !important; }
style.ha-tile-info$: .primary { font-size: 20px !important; font-weight: 600 !important; opacity: 0.75; line-height: 1.3 !important; } .secondary { font-size: 40px !important; font-weight: 700 !important; line-height: 1.15 !important; letter-spacing: -0.5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
